## How you checked it

- [ ] `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Docs updated: the package README, `docs/<package>.md` and the package CHANGELOG

## Safety rules

- [ ] No secret is printed, logged or sent anywhere except the provider it belongs to
- [ ] Trades, launches and posts still show a preview first, need a confirmation and stay within caps
- [ ] `--dry-run` still sends nothing
